description: ZooKeeper 集群监控，覆盖 znode 规模、quorum 选主、Watcher 与会话、请求各处理阶段耗时、连接与流量、磁盘快照、文件句柄、TLS 认证与 JVM，适配 Grafana 7.1.4（schemaVersion 26）。指标口径：1) ZK 指标按 job（zookeeper 抓取任务，单选）+ instance（多选，含 All）过滤；JVM 指标对「ZK 端点自带 jvm_*」与「同机独立 java agent 任务」取并集并以 max 去重，两条链路各有实例变量，任一存在即可出图；2) gauge 类指标（znode_count / ephemerals_count / watch_count / global_sessions / num_alive_connections / outstanding_requests / approximate_data_size / max_latency 等）只取值或用 delta，不套 rate；3) 累计计数器（packets_* / bytes_received_count / commit_count / proposal_count / 各类 *_count 与 *_sum）一律取 rate([5m])；4) 耗时与队列长度类来自 Summary 型数据，统一 rate(_sum)/rate(_count) 还原单次平均值（窗口 10m），分母用 clamp_min 兜底而不是 > 0 过滤——后者会把分母为 0 的时间点整段丢掉，导致低频指标整块 No data；另用 avg_X 与 X{quantile="0.5"} 两支兜底兼容其它导出形态；5) read_per_namespace / write_per_namespace 的观测值是字节数（响应体 / 路径+数据长度），不是操作次数，单位按 Bps 展示；6) 各副本数据一致，Znode / 临时节点 / 全局会话 / 内存数据量取 max 而非 sum（sum 会按副本数翻倍），连接与队列类才按实例对比；7) 全部面板带中文说明，图例为表格形式展示 Min/Max/Current，布局为三列 w8×h6（首行与 JVM 区为 w3 卡片）；8) 分区：概览 / 集群与选主 / JVM / 数据与 Watch / 请求与延迟 / 连接与会话 / 请求处理链 / 磁盘与文件句柄 / 安全与 TLS。

panels.description: 集群健康与规模一览：采集状态、存活实例、Znode 与临时节点、活跃连接、全局会话、Watcher 总数与内存数据量（8 张卡片，均带迷你趋势线）
panels.title: ZooKeeper 概览 Overview

panels.description: 所选实例的指标抓取状态：1=正常、0=失联。取最小值，任一实例掉线即变红；该实例的全部 ZK 指标会同时中断而其它实例仍出数，可据此区分单实例故障与整体采集故障。
panels.title: 采集状态

panels.description: 当前抓取正常的实例数量。集群环境中应与部署的 ZK 节点数一致；数值下降说明有节点离线或指标端口不可达，可结合「实例状态总览」表定位具体节点。
panels.title: 存活实例数

panels.description: 集群 Znode 节点总数。各副本数据完全一致，故取各实例最大值而不是求和（求和会按副本数翻倍）。持续线性增长多为临时节点/顺序节点未清理，突降通常伴随会话批量过期或数据被删除。
panels.title: Znode 总量

panels.description: 临时（ephemeral）节点总数，随会话存活，同样取各实例最大值。正常随业务会话数小幅波动；只增不减说明客户端未正常关闭会话（要等 session 超时才回收），长期抬升会推高 Watcher 与内存压力。
panels.title: 临时节点数

panels.description: 当前活跃客户端 TCP 连接数（连接维度，非会话维度）。长时间高位而会话数不高，多为连接池未复用或重连风暴；骤降通常对应用户端批量断连或网络抖动。
panels.title: 活跃连接

panels.description: 全局会话数（集群级，各副本上报同一值，故取 max 而非求和）。与活跃连接数的比值反映连接复用程度；会话数持续增长而连接数平稳，常见于大量短连接客户端反复创建会话。
panels.title: 全局会话

panels.description: 当前注册的 Watcher 总数。Watcher 是服务端内存对象，数量过高会明显推高 GC 频率与请求延迟；若与 Znode 数同时异常增长，优先排查配置中心类客户端的全量监听。
panels.title: Watch 总数

panels.description: Znode 数据在内存中的近似总字节数（不含节点路径与统计结构开销）。用于评估堆压力：该值叠加连接与 Watcher 对象开销后应远小于堆上限，接近上限时 GC 抖动会放大写延迟。
panels.title: 内存数据量

panels.description: 实例状态总览表 + 9 张选主相关趋势：事务/提案速率、选主耗时、任期、Learner 复制、提案大小、异常事件、Observer Master、过期请求
panels.title: 集群与选主 Quorum & Leader

panels.description: 每个实例的状态快照：仲裁规模（quorum_size）、运行时长（uptime，秒）、Leader 任期（leader_uptime，秒）、Znode 数、活跃连接数、Watcher 数与未完成请求数。非 Leader 实例的 leader_uptime 通常缺失或为 0，可据此识别当前 Leader；任期归零即发生了一次重新选主。
panels.title: 实例状态总览

panels.description: 事务提交（commit_count）、提案（proposal_count）、diff（diff_count）、进入 LOOKING（looking_count）的每秒速率，以及 Leader 侧待同步请求数（pending_syncs，瞬时值，右轴）。commit 反映实际写入吞吐；proposal 明显高于 commit 说明存在被合并或丢弃的提案；looking 出现尖峰表示进入选举流程，与 Leader 任期归零同时出现即为一次选主事件。
panels.title: 事务与提案速率

panels.description: 单次选主的平均耗时（election_time，毫秒，窗口 10m）。集群稳定时没有选主事件、曲线为 0 属正常；出现抬升说明发生过重新选主，耗时越长，期间写入不可用时间越久。曲线为 0 而不是断线，是为了区分「没有选主」与「采集断了」。

targets.expr: (sum by (instance)(rate(election_time_sum{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[10m])) / clamp_min(sum by (instance)(rate(election_time_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[10m])), 1e-9)) or (max by (instance)({__name__=~"avg_election_time|election_time_avg", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"})) or (max by (instance)(election_time{quantile="0.5", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}))

panels.title: 选主平均耗时

panels.description: 实例运行时长（uptime）与当前 Leader 任期（leader_uptime），原始值单位毫秒，已除以 1000 换算为秒。运行时长曲线归零即进程重启，需结合 GC 与 OOM 记录判断原因；只有 Leader 持有非零任期，其余实例为 0 或缺失。
panels.title: 运行时长与 Leader 任期

panels.description: Learner（只读跟随者）、已同步跟随者、已同步非投票跟随者与已同步 Observer 的数量，取各实例最大值避免重复计数。synced_* 持续低于成员总数说明有节点落后于事务日志，需检查其磁盘 IO 与网络时延。这些指标只有 Leader 上报，非 Leader 为空属正常。
panels.title: Learner 与 Observer 数量

panels.description: Leader 向每个 Learner 发送数据包的待发队列长度（learner_handler_qp_size 平均值，按 learner 地址 key 分组，左轴 数量）与 Follower 同步事务的平均耗时（follower_sync_time，毫秒，右轴 耗时）。队列持续增长说明复制跟不上写入；同步耗时抬升说明 follower 落盘或网络跟不上，会拉长仲裁确认并增加被踢出仲裁的风险。

targets.expr: (sum by (instance, key)(rate(learner_handler_qp_size_sum{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[10m])) / clamp_min(sum by (instance, key)(rate(learner_handler_qp_size_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[10m])), 1e-9)) or (max by (instance, key)({__name__=~"avg_learner_handler_qp_size|learner_handler_qp_size_avg", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"})) or (max by (instance, key)(learner_handler_qp_size{quantile="0.5", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}))

(sum by (instance)(rate(follower_sync_time_sum{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[10m])) / clamp_min(sum by (instance)(rate(follower_sync_time_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[10m])), 1e-9)) or (max by (instance)({__name__=~"avg_follower_sync_time|follower_sync_time_avg", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"})) or (max by (instance)(follower_sync_time{quantile="0.5", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}))

panels.title: Learner 复制队列与同步耗时

panels.description: 提案大小（字节）：最近一次（last_proposal_size）、窗口内最大与最小（max/min_proposal_size）。大提案会同时抬高网络与磁盘写入量，并直接拉长仲裁确认延迟；最大值突然抬升多对应批量写或大事务。
panels.title: 提案大小

panels.description: Leader 退位（quit_leading_due_to_disloyal_voter）、不可恢复错误（unrecoverable_error_count）与事务摘要不一致（digest_mismatches_count）的每秒发生次数。三项正常应恒为 0；摘要不一致意味着副本数据出现差异，需立即核对磁盘与日志。
panels.title: 异常事件速率

panels.description: Observer Master 的提交处理与提案处理平均耗时（om_commit_process_time_ms / om_proposal_process_time_ms，毫秒）。该面板只在集群启用 Observer Master（存在 Observer 且版本支持）时才有非零数据；未启用时恒为 0 属正常，不是采集故障。

targets.expr: (sum by (instance)(rate(om_commit_process_time_ms_sum{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[10m])) / clamp_min(sum by (instance)(rate(om_commit_process_time_ms_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[10m])), 1e-9)) or (max by (instance)({__name__=~"avg_om_commit_process_time_ms|om_commit_process_time_ms_avg", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"})) or (max by (instance)(om_commit_process_time_ms{quantile="0.5", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}))

(sum by (instance)(rate(om_proposal_process_time_ms_sum{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[10m])) / clamp_min(sum by (instance)(rate(om_proposal_process_time_ms_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[10m])), 1e-9)) or (max by (instance)({__name__=~"avg_om_proposal_process_time_ms|om_proposal_process_time_ms_avg", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"})) or (max by (instance)(om_proposal_process_time_ms{quantile="0.5", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}))

panels.title: Observer Master 耗时

panels.description: 过期请求（stale_requests）、被丢弃的过期请求（stale_requests_dropped）、过期应答（stale_replies）与连接重校验（connection_revalidate_count）的每秒速率。过期请求出现说明客户端已超时放弃而服务端仍在处理，通常由长 GC、磁盘卡顿或队列积压引起。
panels.title: 过期请求与应答

panels.description: JVM 运行时：堆/非堆水位、类加载、线程与死锁、GC 停顿、线程状态与 JMX 暂停。JVM 指标对「ZK 端点自带 jvm_*（跟随实例变量）」与「同机独立 java agent（跟随 JVM 实例变量）」取并集并以 max 去重
panels.title: JVM

panels.description: 堆区已用字节数（jvm_memory_bytes_used，area=heap），取各实例最大值。老年代持续接近上限会频繁触发 Full GC，直接表现为写延迟毛刺与选主超时。

targets.expr: max(max by (instance)((jvm_memory_bytes_used{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", area="heap"} or jvm_memory_bytes_used{job=~"$jmxjob", instance=~"$jvminstance", area="heap"})))

panels.title: 堆内存已用

panels.description: 堆区上限字节数（jvm_memory_bytes_max，area=heap）。除非改过 -Xmx，该值应长期恒定；若在使用中抬升，说明 JVM 在运行期扩容了堆。

targets.expr: max(max by (instance)((jvm_memory_bytes_max{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", area="heap"} or jvm_memory_bytes_max{job=~"$jmxjob", instance=~"$jvminstance", area="heap"})))

panels.title: 堆内存上限

panels.description: 堆已用 / 堆上限（%），先按实例求比值再取最大（分母 clamp_min 兜底，上限缺失时不会整段消失）。持续高于 85% 说明 GC 后回收效果变差；与「GC 停顿」同时抬升时应优先扩堆或排查内存泄漏。

targets.expr: 100 * max((max by (instance)((jvm_memory_bytes_used{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", area="heap"} or jvm_memory_bytes_used{job=~"$jmxjob", instance=~"$jvminstance", area="heap"}))) / clamp_min((max by (instance)((jvm_memory_bytes_max{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", area="heap"} or jvm_memory_bytes_max{job=~"$jmxjob", instance=~"$jvminstance", area="heap"}))), 1))

panels.title: 堆使用率

panels.description: 非堆区已用字节数（jvm_memory_bytes_used，area=nonheap），含元空间与代码缓存。持续增长多为动态类生成；元空间耗尽会抛 OutOfMemoryError: Metaspace。

targets.expr: max(max by (instance)((jvm_memory_bytes_used{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", area="nonheap"} or jvm_memory_bytes_used{job=~"$jmxjob", instance=~"$jvminstance", area="nonheap"})))

panels.title: 非堆已用

panels.description: JVM 已加载的类数量（jvm_classes_loaded）。稳态下基本恒定；持续增长说明存在动态类生成，可能伴随元空间膨胀。

targets.expr: max(max by (instance)((jvm_classes_loaded{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"} or jvm_classes_loaded{job=~"$jmxjob", instance=~"$jvminstance"})))

panels.title: 已加载类数

panels.description: JVM 当前活动线程数（jvm_threads_current）。连接平稳而线程数持续抬升说明存在阻塞（磁盘、锁或下游），需结合线程状态图确认。

targets.expr: max(max by (instance)((jvm_threads_current{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"} or jvm_threads_current{job=~"$jmxjob", instance=~"$jvminstance"})))

panels.title: 活动线程数

panels.description: JVM 检测到的死锁线程数（jvm_threads_deadlocked）；该指标无序列时按 0 显示。正常恒为 0，出现非零即存在死锁，相关请求会永久挂起。

targets.expr: max(max by (instance)((jvm_threads_deadlocked{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"} or jvm_threads_deadlocked{job=~"$jmxjob", instance=~"$jvminstance"}))) or (count(max by (instance)((jvm_threads_current{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"} or jvm_threads_current{job=~"$jmxjob", instance=~"$jvminstance"}))) * 0)

panels.title: 死锁线程

panels.description: 每秒 GC 停顿时间占每秒的比例（各 GC 类型求和后的 rate），0.01 即 1%。长期高于 5% 说明 GC 已成为瓶颈。
panels.title: GC 停顿占比

panels.description: 各内存池（jvm_memory_pool_bytes_used）的已用字节数，按实例与池名分组，用于定位是哪个池在增长（Eden/Survivor/Old/Metaspace）。老年代持续接近上限会频繁触发 Full GC；新生代频繁回收属正常。
panels.title: 内存池使用

panels.description: 堆、非堆已用字节数（jvm_memory_bytes_used）与堆上限（jvm_memory_bytes_max）对照。堆曲线贴近上限而 GC 停顿同步抬升，即需要扩堆或清理数据；非堆增长要看元空间与代码缓存。

targets.expr: max by (instance)((jvm_memory_bytes_used{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", area="heap"} or jvm_memory_bytes_used{job=~"$jmxjob", instance=~"$jvminstance", area="heap"}))
max by (instance)((jvm_memory_bytes_max{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", area="heap"} or jvm_memory_bytes_max{job=~"$jmxjob", instance=~"$jvminstance", area="heap"}))
max by (instance)((jvm_memory_bytes_used{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", area="nonheap"} or jvm_memory_bytes_used{job=~"$jmxjob", instance=~"$jvminstance", area="nonheap"}))

panels.title: 堆与非堆水位

panels.description: 每秒 GC 停顿时间占每秒的比例，按实例与 GC 类型分组（jvm_gc_collection_seconds_sum 的 rate），0.01 即 1%。该值长期高于 5% 说明 GC 已成瓶颈，需结合堆内存与对象创建速率优化。
panels.title: GC 停顿趋势

panels.description: 按状态（RUNNABLE / WAITING / BLOCKED / TIMED_WAITING）统计的线程数（jvm_threads_state）。BLOCKED 抬升说明存在锁竞争；WAITING 大量堆积多为线程池空闲或等待下游响应。

targets.expr: max by (instance, state)((jvm_threads_state{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"} or jvm_threads_state{job=~"$jmxjob", instance=~"$jvminstance"}))

panels.title: 线程状态

panels.description: 已加载类数（jvm_classes_loaded）与活动线程数（jvm_threads_current）的长期趋势。两者稳态下都应是一条平线；类数持续爬升多为动态代理或脚本引擎不断生成类，线程数爬升则要排查阻塞与连接泄漏。

targets.expr: max by (instance)((jvm_classes_loaded{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"} or jvm_classes_loaded{job=~"$jmxjob", instance=~"$jvminstance"}))
max by (instance)((jvm_threads_current{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"} or jvm_threads_current{job=~"$jmxjob", instance=~"$jvminstance"}))

panels.title: 类加载与线程趋势

panels.description: JMX 指标暂停（jvm_pause_time_ms_sum 的 rate）每秒累计毫秒数。暂停通常来自安全点与 GC，持续抬升会表现为请求延迟毛刺与选举超时，需与「GC 停顿趋势」对照判断。
panels.title: JMX 暂停时间

panels.description: Znode 规模与变化、按命名空间的读写吞吐与增量排名、内存数据量与 Watcher、Watch 事件与死 Watcher、会话重校验
panels.title: 数据与 Watch Data & Watch

panels.description: 每个实例的 Znode 总数（znode_count）与临时节点数（ephemerals_count）。各副本数据一致，看单实例即可；临时节点随会话存活，只增不减说明客户端未正常关闭会话（回收要等 session 超时）。
panels.title: Znode 与临时节点

panels.description: Znode、临时节点与 Watcher 数在 5 分钟窗口内的净变化量（gauge 类指标用 delta，不能套 rate）。持续正值说明节点或监听只增不减；与总量同时抬升时，需排查未清理的临时节点与重复注册的 Watcher。
panels.title: Znode 与 Watch 变化

panels.description: approximate_data_size（Znode 数据在内存中的近似字节数，左轴 容量）与 watch_count（当前注册的 Watcher 总数，右轴 数量）。两者都是服务端内存占用的主要来源：数据量与 Watch 同时爬升时，GC 频率与请求延迟会一起恶化。
panels.title: 内存数据量与 Watcher 总数

panels.description: 按命名空间（SummarySet 的 key 标签）统计的读数据速率：read_per_namespace 的观测值是**响应字节数**（DataTree 里以 totalBytes 记账），不是请求次数，所以单位是字节/秒。排名靠前的命名空间通常是读热点，可据此定位大范围 getChildren 或大节点反复读取。
panels.title: 按命名空间读吞吐

panels.description: 按命名空间统计的写数据速率：write_per_namespace 的观测值是 path.length() + 数据字节数，单位同样是字节/秒（不是写操作次数）。写入量与提案大小、fsync 频率直接相关：某命名空间写吞吐突然抬升，通常会同时看到仲裁确认延迟上升。
panels.title: 按命名空间写吞吐

panels.description: 按所选时间窗（$__range）统计写字节数最大的 10 个命名空间，阶梯线呈现窗口内累计字节数排名。适合排查「某业务命名空间写放大」：排名靠前的通常是配置频繁变更或临时节点批量注册的来源。
panels.title: 命名空间写量 Top10

panels.description: 节点创建、变更、删除与子节点变更四类 Watch 事件的每秒发生次数（对 *_sum 计数器取 rate）。事件速率突增通常对应一次批量变更（如配置全量刷新），会同时抬高写延迟与跨节点广播开销。
panels.title: Watch 事件速率

panels.description: 死 Watcher 的入队（dead_watchers_queued）与清理（dead_watchers_cleared）每秒速率——两者都是累计计数器，直接画原值只会得到单调上升的直线。入队长期高于清理说明清理线程跟不上连接断开速度，会占用内存并延迟会话回收。
panels.title: 死 Watcher 入队与清理

panels.description: 死 Watcher 清理的单次平均耗时（dead_watchers_cleaner_latency，毫秒，左轴）与添加死 Watcher 造成的窗口累计停顿（add_dead_watcher_stall_time，累计毫秒计数器取 increase，右轴 毫秒）。清理耗时抬升说明单次清理的 Watcher 过多，会阻塞请求处理线程。

targets.expr: (sum by (instance)(rate(dead_watchers_cleaner_latency_sum{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[10m])) / clamp_min(sum by (instance)(rate(dead_watchers_cleaner_latency_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[10m])), 1e-9)) or (max by (instance)({__name__=~"avg_dead_watchers_cleaner_latency|dead_watchers_cleaner_latency_avg", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"})) or (max by (instance)(dead_watchers_cleaner_latency{quantile="0.5", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}))

panels.title: 清理耗时与停顿

panels.description: 读/写、提案与仲裁、传播、极值、响应大小、未完成请求、缓存与分位；耗时类统一 rate(_sum)/rate(_count) 得到单次平均值，窗口内无事件时显示 0 而非断线
panels.title: 请求与延迟 Latency

panels.description: 读（readlatency）与写（updatelatency）请求的平均处理耗时，单位毫秒。写延迟对磁盘 fsync 极敏感；读延迟抬升而写延迟平稳多为读请求排队或 GC 停顿。曲线为 0 表示该窗口内没有同类请求，不是采集故障。

targets.expr: (sum by (instance)(rate(readlatency_sum{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[10m])) / clamp_min(sum by (instance)(rate(readlatency_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[10m])), 1e-9)) or (max by (instance)({__name__=~"avg_readlatency|readlatency_avg", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"})) or (max by (instance)(readlatency{quantile="0.5", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}))

(sum by (instance)(rate(updatelatency_sum{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[10m])) / clamp_min(sum by (instance)(rate(updatelatency_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[10m])), 1e-9)) or (max by (instance)({__name__=~"avg_updatelatency|updatelatency_avg", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"})) or (max by (instance)(updatelatency{quantile="0.5", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}))

panels.title: 读/写请求延迟

panels.description: 提案处理（proposal_latency）、仲裁确认（quorum_ack_latency）、确认（ack_latency，SummarySet 按实例做加权平均）的平均耗时，单位毫秒。quorum_ack 直接反映跨节点网络与 follower 落盘速度，是写入链路最关键的一段。

targets.expr: (sum by (instance)(rate(proposal_latency_sum{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[10m])) / clamp_min(sum by (instance)(rate(proposal_latency_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[10m])), 1e-9)) or (max by (instance)({__name__=~"avg_proposal_latency|proposal_latency_avg", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"})) or (max by (instance)(proposal_latency{quantile="0.5", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}))

(sum by (instance)(rate(quorum_ack_latency_sum{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[10m])) / clamp_min(sum by (instance)(rate(quorum_ack_latency_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[10m])), 1e-9)) or (max by (instance)({__name__=~"avg_quorum_ack_latency|quorum_ack_latency_avg", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"})) or (max by (instance)(quorum_ack_latency{quantile="0.5", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}))

(sum by (instance)(rate(ack_latency_sum{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[10m])) / clamp_min(sum by (instance)(rate(ack_latency_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[10m])), 1e-9)) or (max by (instance)({__name__=~"avg_ack_latency|ack_latency_avg", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"})) or (max by (instance)(ack_latency{quantile="0.5", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}))

panels.title: 提案与仲裁延迟

panels.description: 提交传播（commit_propagation_latency）、提案传播（propagation_latency）与提案确认对象创建（proposal_ack_creation_latency）的平均耗时，单位毫秒。传播延迟抬升而本地处理耗时正常，说明瓶颈在节点间网络或 follower 负载。

targets.expr: (sum by (instance)(rate(commit_propagation_latency_sum{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[10m])) / clamp_min(sum by (instance)(rate(commit_propagation_latency_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[10m])), 1e-9)) or (max by (instance)({__name__=~"avg_commit_propagation_latency|commit_propagation_latency_avg", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"})) or (max by (instance)(commit_propagation_latency{quantile="0.5", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}))

(sum by (instance)(rate(propagation_latency_sum{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[10m])) / clamp_min(sum by (instance)(rate(propagation_latency_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[10m])), 1e-9)) or (max by (instance)({__name__=~"avg_propagation_latency|propagation_latency_avg", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"})) or (max by (instance)(propagation_latency{quantile="0.5", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}))

(sum by (instance)(rate(proposal_ack_creation_latency_sum{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[10m])) / clamp_min(sum by (instance)(rate(proposal_ack_creation_latency_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[10m])), 1e-9)) or (max by (instance)({__name__=~"avg_proposal_ack_creation_latency|proposal_ack_creation_latency_avg", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"})) or (max by (instance)(proposal_ack_creation_latency{quantile="0.5", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}))

panels.title: 传播与确认创建延迟

panels.description: 服务端统计的最大、最小与平均请求延迟（max/min/avg_latency，毫秒）。max 远高于 avg 说明存在长尾，常见于单次大事务、磁盘抖动或 GC 停顿；min 长期为 0 属正常。
panels.title: 延迟极值与均值

panels.description: 最近一次、最大与最小客户端响应字节数（last/min/max_client_response_size）。响应体异常增大（如大范围 getChildren）会同时抬高网络带宽与客户端反序列化开销，通常与 Watch 事件风暴同时出现。
panels.title: 客户端响应大小

panels.description: 已接收但尚未处理完的请求数（outstanding_requests，瞬时值）。持续大于 0 说明请求处理能力不足或某类请求被阻塞（常见于 fsync 变慢、大快照、会话队列积压），是判断过载最直接的信号。
panels.title: 未完成请求

panels.description: 响应包缓存与 getChildren 缓存的命中/未命中每秒次数（对计数器取 rate）。未命中率升高意味着缓存复用变差，会放大序列化与网络开销；getChildren 未命中突增常见于树结构被频繁全量遍历。
panels.title: 响应缓存命中与未命中

panels.description: 响应包缓存与 getChildren 缓存的命中率（命中 /(命中+未命中)），0.9 即 90%。命中率下滑意味着缓存复用变差，通常与大量首次访问或树结构变更同时发生；分母用 clamp_min 兜底，无请求时显示 0 而非 Inf。

targets.expr: sum by (instance)(rate(response_packet_cache_hits{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[5m])) / clamp_min(sum by (instance)(rate(response_packet_cache_hits{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[5m])) + sum by (instance)(rate(response_packet_cache_misses{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[5m])), 1e-9)

sum by (instance)(rate(response_packet_get_children_cache_hits{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[5m])) / clamp_min(sum by (instance)(rate(response_packet_get_children_cache_hits{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[5m])) + sum by (instance)(rate(response_packet_get_children_cache_misses{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[5m])), 1e-9)

panels.title: 响应缓存命中率

panels.description: 由 Summary 的 quantile 标签得到的请求耗时分布：读延迟 P50、读延迟 P99 与写延迟 P99（毫秒）。P99 远高于 P50 说明存在长尾；平均值稳定而 P99 抬升同样需要关注，两者互为印证。
panels.title: 请求延迟分布 P50/P99

panels.description: 会话与连接规模、建连/拒绝/断开速率、连接丢弃概率与令牌赤字、收发包与字节速率、平均请求大小
panels.title: 连接与会话 Session & Connection

panels.description: 全局会话（global_sessions，集群级取 max）、本地会话（local_sessions）与活跃客户端 TCP 连接数（num_alive_connections）。本地会话远低于全局会话属正常（非 Leader 只统计本机连接）；会话数涨而连接数平，多为短连接客户端反复建会话。
panels.title: 会话与连接规模

panels.description: 新建连接（connection_request_count）、被拒绝（connection_rejected）与异常断开（connection_drop_count）的每秒速率。拒绝与断开同时抬升通常意味着触及 maxClientCnxns 上限或端口耗尽，需排查连接泄漏。
panels.title: 建连、拒绝与断开速率

panels.description: 连接被随机丢弃的概率（connection_drop_probability，0~1，左轴 概率）与连接令牌赤字的每秒速率（connection_token_deficit，右轴 速率）。概率非零说明已进入保护性丢弃阶段，客户端会感知为随机连接失败；赤字持续为正说明建连请求长期超出允许速率。
panels.title: 连接丢弃概率与令牌赤字

panels.description: 收包与发包速率（packets_received / packets_sent，pps）。这两个指标在 ZK 端点上被声明为 gauge，但语义是自启动起的累计计数，必须取 rate 才有意义，直接画原值只会得到单调上升的直线。收发长期不对称说明请求与响应体量差异大。
panels.title: 包速率

panels.description: 接收字节速率 = rate(bytes_received_count[5m])，字节/秒。bytes_received_count 同样是累计计数器。与包速率结合可估算平均请求大小（见右侧面板），用于识别批量写与大事务。
panels.title: 接收字节速率

panels.description: 平均请求大小 = 接收字节速率 / 收包速率（字节/包，分母 clamp_min 兜底避免 Inf）。ZK 请求以较小为主（几十到几百字节），该值突然抬升说明出现了批量写或大事务；长期很小而 pps 很高，多为连接保活类小包。

targets.expr: sum by (instance)(rate(bytes_received_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[5m])) / clamp_min(sum by (instance)(rate(packets_received{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[5m])), 1e-9)

panels.title: 平均请求大小

panels.description: Prep → Sync → Commit → Final 四个阶段：处理与排队耗时、队列长度、入队/调度速率、空池等待与限流；耗时取 rate(_sum)/rate(_count)，队列取 *_queue_size 平均值
panels.title: 请求处理链 Processors

panels.description: PrepRequestProcessor 的单请求平均处理耗时（prep_process_time）、排队耗时（prep_processor_queue_time_ms）与会话关闭处理耗时（close_session_prep_time），单位毫秒。排队耗时占比高说明该阶段线程不足或下游过慢。

targets.expr: (sum by (instance)(rate(prep_process_time_sum{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[10m])) / clamp_min(sum by (instance)(rate(prep_process_time_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[10m])), 1e-9)) or (max by (instance)({__name__=~"avg_prep_process_time|prep_process_time_avg", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"})) or (max by (instance)(prep_process_time{quantile="0.5", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}))

(sum by (instance)(rate(prep_processor_queue_time_ms_sum{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[10m])) / clamp_min(sum by (instance)(rate(prep_processor_queue_time_ms_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[10m])), 1e-9)) or (max by (instance)({__name__=~"avg_prep_processor_queue_time_ms|prep_processor_queue_time_ms_avg", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"})) or (max by (instance)(prep_processor_queue_time_ms{quantile="0.5", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}))

(sum by (instance)(rate(close_session_prep_time_sum{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[10m])) / clamp_min(sum by (instance)(rate(close_session_prep_time_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[10m])), 1e-9)) or (max by (instance)({__name__=~"avg_close_session_prep_time|close_session_prep_time_avg", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"})) or (max by (instance)(close_session_prep_time{quantile="0.5", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}))

panels.title: Prep 处理耗时

panels.description: Prep 阶段队列长度（prep_processor_queue_size 平均值，左轴 队列长度）、变更入队/移除速率（outstanding_changes_queued/removed）与每秒入队请求数（prep_processor_request_queued，右轴 速率）。队列持续抬升而移除速率不升，说明请求进入速度超过处理速度。

targets.expr: (sum by (instance)(rate(prep_processor_queue_size_sum{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[10m])) / clamp_min(sum by (instance)(rate(prep_processor_queue_size_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[10m])), 1e-9)) or (max by (instance)({__name__=~"avg_prep_processor_queue_size|prep_processor_queue_size_avg", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"})) or (max by (instance)(prep_processor_queue_size{quantile="0.5", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}))

panels.title: Prep 队列与入队速率

panels.description: SyncRequestProcessor 的单请求平均处理耗时（sync_process_time）、队列冲刷耗时（sync_processor_queue_flush_time_ms，毫秒，左轴）、队列长度与批大小（sync_processor_queue_size / sync_processor_batch_size 平均值，右轴 数量）。冲刷耗时直接对应批量落盘，磁盘变慢会同步抬高写延迟。

targets.expr: (sum by (instance)(rate(sync_process_time_sum{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[10m])) / clamp_min(sum by (instance)(rate(sync_process_time_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[10m])), 1e-9)) or (max by (instance)({__name__=~"avg_sync_process_time|sync_process_time_avg", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"})) or (max by (instance)(sync_process_time{quantile="0.5", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}))

(sum by (instance)(rate(sync_processor_queue_flush_time_ms_sum{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[10m])) / clamp_min(sum by (instance)(rate(sync_processor_queue_flush_time_ms_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[10m])), 1e-9)) or (max by (instance)({__name__=~"avg_sync_processor_queue_flush_time_ms|sync_processor_queue_flush_time_ms_avg", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"})) or (max by (instance)(sync_processor_queue_flush_time_ms{quantile="0.5", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}))

(sum by (instance)(rate(sync_processor_queue_size_sum{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[10m])) / clamp_min(sum by (instance)(rate(sync_processor_queue_size_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[10m])), 1e-9)) or (max by (instance)({__name__=~"avg_sync_processor_queue_size|sync_processor_queue_size_avg", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"})) or (max by (instance)(sync_processor_queue_size{quantile="0.5", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}))

(sum by (instance)(rate(sync_processor_batch_size_sum{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[10m])) / clamp_min(sum by (instance)(rate(sync_processor_batch_size_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[10m])), 1e-9)) or (max by (instance)({__name__=~"avg_sync_processor_batch_size|sync_processor_batch_size_avg", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"})) or (max by (instance)(sync_processor_batch_size{quantile="0.5", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}))

panels.title: Sync 处理耗时与队列

panels.description: CommitProcessor 的单请求平均处理耗时（commit_process_time）、读/写提交耗时（read/write_commitproc_time_ms）、服务端与本地写提交耗时（server/local_write_committed_time_ms）及写批处理耗时（write_batch_time_in_commit_processor），单位毫秒。

targets.expr: (sum by (instance)(rate(commit_process_time_sum{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[10m])) / clamp_min(sum by (instance)(rate(commit_process_time_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[10m])), 1e-9)) or (max by (instance)({__name__=~"avg_commit_process_time|commit_process_time_avg", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"})) or (max by (instance)(commit_process_time{quantile="0.5", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}))

(sum by (instance)(rate(read_commitproc_time_ms_sum{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[10m])) / clamp_min(sum by (instance)(rate(read_commitproc_time_ms_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[10m])), 1e-9)) or (max by (instance)({__name__=~"avg_read_commitproc_time_ms|read_commitproc_time_ms_avg", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"})) or (max by (instance)(read_commitproc_time_ms{quantile="0.5", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}))

(sum by (instance)(rate(write_commitproc_time_ms_sum{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[10m])) / clamp_min(sum by (instance)(rate(write_commitproc_time_ms_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[10m])), 1e-9)) or (max by (instance)({__name__=~"avg_write_commitproc_time_ms|write_commitproc_time_ms_avg", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"})) or (max by (instance)(write_commitproc_time_ms{quantile="0.5", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}))

(sum by (instance)(rate(server_write_committed_time_ms_sum{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[10m])) / clamp_min(sum by (instance)(rate(server_write_committed_time_ms_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[10m])), 1e-9)) or (max by (instance)({__name__=~"avg_server_write_committed_time_ms|server_write_committed_time_ms_avg", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"})) or (max by (instance)(server_write_committed_time_ms{quantile="0.5", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}))

(sum by (instance)(rate(local_write_committed_time_ms_sum{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[10m])) / clamp_min(sum by (instance)(rate(local_write_committed_time_ms_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[10m])), 1e-9)) or (max by (instance)({__name__=~"avg_local_write_committed_time_ms|local_write_committed_time_ms_avg", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"})) or (max by (instance)(local_write_committed_time_ms{quantile="0.5", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}))

(sum by (instance)(rate(write_batch_time_in_commit_processor_sum{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[10m])) / clamp_min(sum by (instance)(rate(write_batch_time_in_commit_processor_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[10m])), 1e-9)) or (max by (instance)({__name__=~"avg_write_batch_time_in_commit_processor|write_batch_time_in_commit_processor_avg", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"})) or (max by (instance)(write_batch_time_in_commit_processor{quantile="0.5", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}))

panels.title: Commit 处理耗时

panels.description: Commit 阶段读、写、commit 三类请求的排队长度（*_commit_proc_req_queued 平均值）、并发处理数（concurrent_request_processing_in_commit_processor）与会话队列中的请求数（requests_in_session_queue、pending_session_queue_size）。读队列积压会拖慢所有读请求。

targets.expr: (sum by (instance)(rate(read_commit_proc_req_queued_sum{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[10m])) / clamp_min(sum by (instance)(rate(read_commit_proc_req_queued_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[10m])), 1e-9)) or (max by (instance)({__name__=~"avg_read_commit_proc_req_queued|read_commit_proc_req_queued_avg", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"})) or (max by (instance)(read_commit_proc_req_queued{quantile="0.5", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}))

(sum by (instance)(rate(write_commit_proc_req_queued_sum{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[10m])) / clamp_min(sum by (instance)(rate(write_commit_proc_req_queued_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[10m])), 1e-9)) or (max by (instance)({__name__=~"avg_write_commit_proc_req_queued|write_commit_proc_req_queued_avg", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"})) or (max by (instance)(write_commit_proc_req_queued{quantile="0.5", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}))

(sum by (instance)(rate(commit_commit_proc_req_queued_sum{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[10m])) / clamp_min(sum by (instance)(rate(commit_commit_proc_req_queued_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[10m])), 1e-9)) or (max by (instance)({__name__=~"avg_commit_commit_proc_req_queued|commit_commit_proc_req_queued_avg", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"})) or (max by (instance)(commit_commit_proc_req_queued{quantile="0.5", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}))

(sum by (instance)(rate(concurrent_request_processing_in_commit_processor_sum{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[10m])) / clamp_min(sum by (instance)(rate(concurrent_request_processing_in_commit_processor_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[10m])), 1e-9)) or (max by (instance)({__name__=~"avg_concurrent_request_processing_in_commit_processor|concurrent_request_processing_in_commit_processor_avg", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"})) or (max by (instance)(concurrent_request_processing_in_commit_processor{quantile="0.5", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}))

(sum by (instance)(rate(requests_in_session_queue_sum{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[10m])) / clamp_min(sum by (instance)(rate(requests_in_session_queue_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[10m])), 1e-9)) or (max by (instance)({__name__=~"avg_requests_in_session_queue|requests_in_session_queue_avg", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"})) or (max by (instance)(requests_in_session_queue{quantile="0.5", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}))

(sum by (instance)(rate(pending_session_queue_size_sum{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[10m])) / clamp_min(sum by (instance)(rate(pending_session_queue_size_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[10m])), 1e-9)) or (max by (instance)({__name__=~"avg_pending_session_queue_size|pending_session_queue_size_avg", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"})) or (max by (instance)(pending_session_queue_size{quantile="0.5", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}))

panels.title: Commit 请求队列

panels.description: 读/写提交请求的发出速率（read/write_commit_proc_issued）、从会话队列发出的读请求（reads_issued_from_session_queue）、写后读（reads_after_write_in_session_queue）、会话队列排空（session_queues_drained）与请求提交（request_commit_queued）的每秒次数。写后读比例高说明客户端一致性要求强，会放大读延迟。
panels.title: Commit 调度速率

panels.description: FinalRequestProcessor 的写（write_final_proc_time_ms）与读（read_final_proc_time_ms）平均处理耗时，单位毫秒。这是请求链路最后一段，主要包含数据节点查找与响应序列化；耗时抬升常见于 Znode 数量过多或大响应。

targets.expr: (sum by (instance)(rate(write_final_proc_time_ms_sum{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[10m])) / clamp_min(sum by (instance)(rate(write_final_proc_time_ms_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[10m])), 1e-9)) or (max by (instance)({__name__=~"avg_write_final_proc_time_ms|write_final_proc_time_ms_avg", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"})) or (max by (instance)(write_final_proc_time_ms{quantile="0.5", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}))

(sum by (instance)(rate(read_final_proc_time_ms_sum{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[10m])) / clamp_min(sum by (instance)(rate(read_final_proc_time_ms_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[10m])), 1e-9)) or (max by (instance)({__name__=~"avg_read_final_proc_time_ms|read_final_proc_time_ms_avg", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"})) or (max by (instance)(read_final_proc_time_ms{quantile="0.5", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}))

panels.title: Final 处理耗时

panels.description: Commit 阶段读请求因线程池无空闲线程而等待的平均耗时（time_waiting_empty_pool_in_commit_processor_read_ms，毫秒，左轴），以及请求排队等令牌（request_throttle_wait_count）、超大请求被拒（large_requests_rejected）、过期请求丢弃（stale_requests_dropped）的每秒速率（右轴）。限流等待出现说明写请求速率已触及内部节流阈值。

targets.expr: (sum by (instance)(rate(time_waiting_empty_pool_in_commit_processor_read_ms_sum{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[10m])) / clamp_min(sum by (instance)(rate(time_waiting_empty_pool_in_commit_processor_read_ms_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[10m])), 1e-9)) or (max by (instance)({__name__=~"avg_time_waiting_empty_pool_in_commit_processor_read_ms|time_waiting_empty_pool_in_commit_processor_read_ms_avg", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"})) or (max by (instance)(time_waiting_empty_pool_in_commit_processor_read_ms{quantile="0.5", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}))

panels.title: 空池等待与限流

panels.description: 会话队列中的请求数与写后读次数：requests_in_session_queue、pending_session_queue_size（平均值，左轴 队列长度）与 reads_after_write_in_session_queue、session_queues_drained（每秒速率，右轴）。写后读多说明客户端强一致性读多，会放大读延迟；会话队列持续堆积说明 Commit 阶段处理不过来。

targets.expr: (sum by (instance)(rate(requests_in_session_queue_sum{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[10m])) / clamp_min(sum by (instance)(rate(requests_in_session_queue_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[10m])), 1e-9)) or (max by (instance)({__name__=~"avg_requests_in_session_queue|requests_in_session_queue_avg", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"})) or (max by (instance)(requests_in_session_queue{quantile="0.5", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}))

(sum by (instance)(rate(pending_session_queue_size_sum{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[10m])) / clamp_min(sum by (instance)(rate(pending_session_queue_size_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[10m])), 1e-9)) or (max by (instance)({__name__=~"avg_pending_session_queue_size|pending_session_queue_size_avg", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"})) or (max by (instance)(pending_session_queue_size{quantile="0.5", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}))

panels.title: 会话队列与写后读

panels.description: 事务日志 fsync、快照生成、启动加载、Inflight 快照与差异、文件描述符用量与使用率；fsync 耗时是写延迟的物理下限
panels.title: 磁盘与文件句柄 Disk & Files

panels.description: 事务日志 fsync 的平均耗时（fsynctime，毫秒，左轴 耗时）与每秒 fsync 次数（fsynctime_count，右轴 速率）。fsync 耗时是写延迟的物理下限：耗时抬升说明磁盘 IO 饱和或存在争用；次数与耗时同时抬升说明写压力大。曲线为 0 表示窗口内没有写请求，不是采集故障。

targets.expr: (sum by (instance)(rate(fsynctime_sum{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[10m])) / clamp_min(sum by (instance)(rate(fsynctime_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[10m])), 1e-9)) or (max by (instance)({__name__=~"avg_fsynctime|fsynctime_avg", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"})) or (max by (instance)(fsynctime{quantile="0.5", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}))

panels.title: Fsync 平均耗时与次数

panels.description: 生成快照的平均耗时（snapshottime，毫秒，左轴 耗时）与快照生成速率（snap_count，右轴 速率）。快照次数异常增多说明事务日志增长过快（snapCount 阈值被频繁触发）；快照过于频繁会与正常写流量争抢磁盘。

targets.expr: (sum by (instance)(rate(snapshottime_sum{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[10m])) / clamp_min(sum by (instance)(rate(snapshottime_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[10m])), 1e-9)) or (max by (instance)({__name__=~"avg_snapshottime|snapshottime_avg", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"})) or (max by (instance)(snapshottime{quantile="0.5", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}))

panels.title: 快照平均耗时与次数

panels.description: 启动时加载数据库（dbinittime）、加载快照（startup_snap_load_time）的平均耗时（毫秒，左轴）与重放事务数（startup_txns_loaded，右轴 数量）。仅在实例启动后短时间内有值；重放数远大于常态说明快照已过期，恢复时间会明显变长。

targets.expr: (sum by (instance)(rate(dbinittime_sum{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[10m])) / clamp_min(sum by (instance)(rate(dbinittime_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[10m])), 1e-9)) or (max by (instance)({__name__=~"avg_dbinittime|dbinittime_avg", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"})) or (max by (instance)(dbinittime{quantile="0.5", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}))

(sum by (instance)(rate(startup_snap_load_time_sum{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[10m])) / clamp_min(sum by (instance)(rate(startup_snap_load_time_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[10m])), 1e-9)) or (max by (instance)({__name__=~"avg_startup_snap_load_time|startup_snap_load_time_avg", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"})) or (max by (instance)(startup_snap_load_time{quantile="0.5", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}))

(sum by (instance)(rate(startup_txns_loaded_sum{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[10m])) / clamp_min(sum by (instance)(rate(startup_txns_loaded_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[10m])), 1e-9)) or (max by (instance)({__name__=~"avg_startup_txns_loaded|startup_txns_loaded_avg", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"})) or (max by (instance)(startup_txns_loaded{quantile="0.5", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}))

panels.title: 启动加载耗时与事务数

panels.description: 正在进行的快照（inflight_snap_count）与差异同步（inflight_diff_count）的数量平均值（单位为「个」，不是毫秒）。两者同时抬升说明 follower 正在做大流量追赶，期间 Leader 的内存与磁盘压力上升；长期不为 0 说明有节点反复落后，应检查该节点磁盘与网络。

targets.expr: (sum by (instance)(rate(inflight_snap_count_sum{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[10m])) / clamp_min(sum by (instance)(rate(inflight_snap_count_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[10m])), 1e-9)) or (max by (instance)({__name__=~"avg_inflight_snap_count|inflight_snap_count_avg", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"})) or (max by (instance)(inflight_snap_count{quantile="0.5", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}))

(sum by (instance)(rate(inflight_diff_count_sum{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[10m])) / clamp_min(sum by (instance)(rate(inflight_diff_count_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[10m])), 1e-9)) or (max by (instance)({__name__=~"avg_inflight_diff_count|inflight_diff_count_avg", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"})) or (max by (instance)(inflight_diff_count{quantile="0.5", job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}))

panels.title: Inflight 快照与差异

panels.description: 进程已用文件描述符数（open_file_descriptor_count）与进程可用上限（max_file_descriptor_count）。两条线之间的距离就是剩余余量；持续增长多为事务日志/快照句柄未释放或连接泄漏，逼近上限时 ZK 会拒绝新连接并出现写入失败。
panels.title: 打开文件描述符

panels.description: 文件描述符使用率 = open_file_descriptor_count / max_file_descriptor_count（%），先按实例求比值再取最大（分母 clamp_min 兜底，上限缺失时不会整段消失）。超过 80% 时新连接与日志写入随时可能失败，应先确认是否存在句柄泄漏，再考虑调大 ulimit。

targets.expr: 100 * max((max by (instance)(open_file_descriptor_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"})) / clamp_min((max by (instance)(max_file_descriptor_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"})), 1))

panels.title: 文件描述符使用率

panels.description: TLS 握手、集群内认证与非 mTLS 连接：正常运行时超时、认证失败与非 mTLS 连接应全为 0
panels.title: 安全与 TLS Security

panels.description: TLS 握手超时的每秒次数（tls_handshake_exceeded，累计计数器取 rate，左轴 速率）与当前进行中的握手数（outstanding_tls_handshake，右轴 数量）。出现超时说明握手阶段被阻塞（证书链过大、CPU 饱和或网络抖动）；未完成的握手会一直占用连接槽位。
panels.title: TLS 握手超时与进行中握手

panels.description: 集群内认证失败（ensemble_auth_fail）、成功（ensemble_auth_success）与跳过（ensemble_auth_skip）的每秒次数。fail 持续出现说明节点间 SASL/证书配置不一致，会影响 quorum 建立；skip 有值表示未启用集群认证。
panels.title: 集群内认证

panels.description: 当前非 mTLS 的远端与本地连接数（non_mtls_remote_conn_count / non_mtls_local_conn_count）。启用 TLS 强制认证后应恒为 0；出现非零说明仍有客户端走明文端口，需排查客户端配置或端口暴露面。
panels.title: 非 mTLS 连接
